evals.name: latest-publication-receipt-drift
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request. Do not use live Git or forge tools; give the deterministic helper flow, final publication audit, and handoff decision.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses one deterministic Graphite transport and canonical-repair flow, runs the helper's final publisher audit, treats sequence 4 as authoritative, and blocks verified stack handoff because the latest receipt drifts even though sequence 3 matches live state.
expectations: The response uses submit_draft_stack.py and its final audit_reviewable_pr.py audit command instead of manually inferring publication success.
The response treats only the authoritative latest receipt as valid evidence and does not substitute matching sequence 3 for drifting sequence 4.
The response rejects canonical-repair-complete and verified stack handoff when the final audit reports drift.
The response performs no automatic retry, rollback, reconciliation, ready mutation, or merge actuation.
